note: Release artifact. Backend may evolve; this surface only changes with a new version + re-review. Eval results per version live in registry/results/. v1.1 2026-09-13: truth-state model (status/confidence/sources/checked_at), honest RDAP wording.

tools.name: check_exact_domain
tools.description: Check the current registration record for an exact domain name via public RDAP data. Use when the user asks if a specific domain is taken, free, or available. A no-record result is not a purchase guarantee.

tools.name: batch_check_domains
tools.description: Check current registration records for up to 20 exact domain names at once. Use when the user lists several domains to compare.

tools.name: find_available_domains
tools.description: Suggest domain names with no current registration record, for a business, brand or idea. Use when the user wants domain ideas rather than checking one exact name. Suggestions are RDAP-checked, not purchase-guaranteed.
